commit.message:
experiment(perf): gate replay, seed phase

Not for upstream. Real aggregator output from both experiment runs, committed
so the pinned benchmark-action can be driven seed-then-compare across two
commits. This commit carries no replay-data/, so every tier takes the seed
path.
